sources.scope: 38 valid distinct Pinellas County land polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Saint Petersburg metropolitan WUP locator in Florida. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row batches, all 38 fresh native PARCELID reads, valid absence, footprint and binding passed. Publisher-coded PARCELSUBTYPE=0 is Land Polygon; unit/subsurface/discrepancy classes are outside this explicit ground scope, which is enforced on every returned feature. Qualified joined column names are retained exactly. Native EPSG:3857 GeoJSON is requested with the documented geometryPrecision=6 parameter (one micrometre in response metres), retained without local rounding, and transformed explicitly only after CRS/precision verification. Earlier unfiltered/float-serialization failures remain preserved. Independent EPSG:32617 GEOS found no invalid/duplicate geometries and two narrow overlaps totalling 0.27016 m². Original unrounded native responses reproduce both as boundary slivers about 3.5 millimetres wide; they remain unchanged and are accepted for bounded reference use. The county feed covers nearby metropolitan ground, including the exact WUP point, without establishing Saint Petersburg municipal-only or citywide coverage, legal title, survey accuracy or long-term key continuity.
